scope: reused-development TRAIN; already consumed; NOT fresh, confirmation, blind, or official

metric_definitions.window: station-25 to station+25; interpolated XY/lateral endpoints; continuous forward/no seam; all baseline-eligible windows retained
metric_definitions.steering: Final issued command held over actual pre/post interval, including partial terminal holds; integral command-s; variation at command jumps strictly inside window, no artificial endpoint zero jumps
metric_definitions.return_definition: Valid physical rear-clear; abs lateral<=1m sustained .24s, confirmed before min(clear+2s,next greater-station obstacle entry,episode end); paired common horizon; retain censors/pending runs; bound is descriptive, not KM/RMST
metric_definitions.weighting: Per-object relative changes averaged within each ordinary cell, then equal cells; directions also require both ordinary geometry means negative; zero baseline gets no reduction credit
metric_definitions.safety: All six objects/cell, including unpassed; touching contact OR sampled clearance<=0; unassociated collision evidence rejects; all natural DNFs retained
metric_definitions.scope: Eight outcome-selected consumed TRAIN layouts/five roads; ordinary four layouts/two roads; not fresh/confirmation/blind/official
